environment.description: Node.js 18.x application deployed on an EC2 instance (m5.large) in a public subnet with a direct public IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no network ACL restrictions beyond default. The native addon (native_addon.node) is compiled with -O2 without ASAN or heap hardening. Process runs as ec2-user with default ulimits.
